intro: Chat Guard safely previews public-chat rule matches before any future moderation enforcement is considered. This version only observes and stores bounded pseudonymous incident metadata.

sections.title: 1. Start safely
sections.description: Select platforms and keep simulations excluded during normal use.
sections.notice: Observe-only means no warnings, message deletion, timeouts, bans, Streamer.bot actions, or provider mutations can occur.

sections.title: 2. Trusted viewers
sections.description: Use stable platform IDs and normalized roles to avoid display-name impersonation.

sections.title: 3. Content and link signals
sections.description: Literal terms, normalized domain policy, link count, caps, repeated-character, and length rules.

sections.title: 4. Repeated messages
sections.description: Flag the same normalized message from the same stable account within a short bounded window.

sections.title: 5. Privacy and retention
sections.description: Limit private incident and repeat-detection state.
sections.notice: Chat Guard never writes message text, names, avatars, or platform account IDs to its state. It stores salted hashes, platform, time, rule IDs, and simulation status only.
